name: Inkling 2 Mini
context_scaling: Card states a 1M-token context window; config.json declares model_max_length 1048576 with log-scaling RoPE (log_scaling_n_floor 8192, log_scaling_alpha 0.1) on top of relative-position bias terms (d_rel 16, rel_extent 1024). No YaRN/NTK factor is printed.
attention_variant: hybrid: 20 of 24 layers are sliding-window attention (sliding_window_size 1024), 4 layers are global (local_layer_ids lists the 20 local layers); GQA 24 Q / 8 KV heads at head_dim 128
notes: ADDED 2026-11-21. New base model, not a derivative: Thinking Machines' second open release (model_type inkling2_loop_text, custom code). safetensors.total 26,388,646,440 BF16 per the HF API (?blobs=true); card prints '26.4B, 3.4B active'. Active-param arithmetic: 24 layers x 8 of 128 routed experts x intermed 1152 with hidden 2304, no shared expert (n_shared_experts 0), so the per-token active count is dominated by attention + 8 expert FFNs; the card does not print the multiplication, so 3.4 is a VENDOR number, not derived here. LOOPING: config loop_config core_start 6, core_end 18, num_passes 3 - the middle 12 layers run three times from the same weights, giving 48 layer applications from 24 layers of weights. The card says each extra pass adds ~1.0B effective active parameters, i.e. 5.4B effective active per token; flops_per_token_active here uses the 3.4B single-pass figure for consistency with the rest of the catalog, so it UNDERSTATES real per-token compute by roughly 1.6x. KV BASIS: 16384 bytes/token = 4 global layers x 8 KV heads x 128 head_dim x 2 (K and V) x 2 bytes. The other 20 layers are sliding-window with window 1024, so their KV saturates at ~1024 tokens and does not grow. NOT ESTABLISHED: whether each of the three loop passes keeps its own KV for the 12 looped layers. If it does, the growing cache triples to ~49 KB/token; the card and config do not say. Distributed as a single ~20GB checkpoint in mixed NVFP4 + MXFP8, and the card names 1x DGX Spark, Apple silicon >= 32GB, or any GPU >= 32GB VRAM as sufficient - which is the reason this record exists despite the 26B total. Card is the only source; every benchmark row is a vendor claim.
